'''Brandon Allen Choke the Chicken''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Brandon Allen]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-11034">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11034 Choke the Chicken], DeckTech (Brandon "Sundevil" Allen, 10 October 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/11034/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/11034/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018111334/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11034/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Brandon Allen]]
* '''Published:''' 10 October 2000 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''Choke the Chicken''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hidden Base / Systems Will Slip Through Your Fingers|SE-L-hiddenbase.gif|label=Hidden Base}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Heading For The Medical Frigate|DS2-L-headingforthemedicalfrigate.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PDS2 HB Allen LS 2000 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' This deck tries to counter almost everything.  It has power in the sky and on the ground, while using Aquaris to get the generation going.
